title: SMTCE: A Social Media Text Classification Evaluation Benchmark and BERTology Models for Vietnamese
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It evaluates models on four social media text classification tasks in Vietnamese: constructive speech detection, complaint comment detection, emotion recognition, and hate speech detection.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on evaluating monolingual and multilingual BERT-based models for general social media text classification in Vietnamese.
